propositions: RemoteRef.instance field is never populated in production code, only in tests, making deployment identity unobservable on the inbound path
Backend protocol lacks a declared remote_ref() method despite FakeBackend implementing it, creating an asymmetry where test doubles are more capable than production backends
The instance value must be derived from normalized base URL and injected at backend construction time, not resolved at call time, to avoid config-context coupling in contract tests

RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone, and this limitation must be documented and pinned by tests
vendor field already separates Cloud from DataCenter deployments, so instance only disambiguates multiple deployments of the same vendor
